info.headline: Notify NYC - MTA Suspension - 6 Train (BX)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-05-2026 at 04:46 PM.
Due to a person struck by a train, 6 train service is suspended in both directions between Parkchester and Pelham Bay Park. Consider alternate routes and allow for additional travel time.
For more information, please visit www.mta.info.
